dialogue.text: Hi everyone, I'm Esther.
dialogue.zh: 大家好，我是Esther。
dialogue.ja: みなさん、こんにちは。エスターです。
dialogue.local: Hi everyone, I'm Esther.
dialogue.en: Hi everyone, I'm Esther.

dialogue.text: In this video, I will introduce the future simple tense using will and be going to.
dialogue.zh: 在這個影片中，我將介紹使用 will 和 be going to 的未來簡單式。
dialogue.ja: この動画では、will と be going to を使った未来形を紹介します。
dialogue.local: In this video, I will introduce the future simple tense using will and be going to.
dialogue.en: In this video, I will introduce the future simple tense using will and be going to.

dialogue.text: This is a very important tense that will help you express future actions and plans.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個非常重要的時態，能幫助你表達未來的行動和計畫。
dialogue.ja: これは未来の行動や計画を表すのにとても大切な時制です。
dialogue.local: This is a very important tense that will help you express future actions and plans.
dialogue.en: This is a very important tense that will help you express future actions and plans.

dialogue.text: There's a lot to learn, so let's get started.
dialogue.zh: 內容很多，我們開始吧。
dialogue.ja: 学ぶことがたくさんあります。さあ、始めましょう。
dialogue.local: There's a lot to learn, so let's get started.
dialogue.en: There's a lot to learn, so let's get started.

dialogue.text: The future simple tense can be used to express a future action.
dialogue.zh: 未來簡單式可以用來表達未來的行動。
dialogue.ja: 未来形は未来の行動を表すために使います。
dialogue.local: The future simple tense can be used to express a future action.
dialogue.en: The future simple tense can be used to express a future action.

dialogue.text: Let's take a look at some examples.
dialogue.zh: 讓我們來看一些例子。
dialogue.ja: いくつか例を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: Let's take a look at some examples.
dialogue.en: Let's take a look at some examples.

dialogue.text: I'm cold.
dialogue.zh: 我很冷。
dialogue.ja: 寒いです。
dialogue.local: I'm cold.
dialogue.en: I'm cold.

dialogue.text: Well, that's right now.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那是現在的狀況。
dialogue.ja: それは今のことですね。
dialogue.local: Well, that's right now.
dialogue.en: Well, that's right now.

dialogue.text: I will close the window.
dialogue.zh: 我會關窗戶。
dialogue.ja: 窓を閉めます。
dialogue.local: I will close the window.
dialogue.en: I will close the window.

dialogue.text: We start with the subject, will and then the base verb.
dialogue.zh: 我們從主詞開始，接著是 will，然後是動詞原形。
dialogue.ja: 主語のあとに will を置き、その後に動詞の原形を続けます。
dialogue.local: We start with the subject, will and then the base verb.
dialogue.en: We start with the subject, will and then the base verb.

dialogue.text: I will close the window.
dialogue.zh: 我會關窗戶。
dialogue.ja: 窓を閉めます。
dialogue.local: I will close the window.
dialogue.en: I will close the window.

dialogue.text: In this example, I'm making a sudden decision because how I feel right now.
dialogue.zh: 在這個例子中，我是因為現在的感覺而突然做出決定。
dialogue.ja: この例では、今の気持ちから急に決めました。
dialogue.local: In this example, I'm making a sudden decision because how I feel right now.
dialogue.en: In this example, I'm making a sudden decision because how I feel right now.

dialogue.text: I will close the window because I'm cold right now.
dialogue.zh: 我會關窗戶，因為我現在很冷。
dialogue.ja: 今寒いので、窓を閉めます。
dialogue.local: I will close the window because I'm cold right now.
dialogue.en: I will close the window because I'm cold right now.

dialogue.text: I will be at the library tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我明天會在圖書館。
dialogue.ja: 明日、図書館にいます。
dialogue.local: I will be at the library tomorrow.
dialogue.en: I will be at the library tomorrow.

dialogue.text: Again, you start with the subject and then will.
dialogue.zh: 同樣地，先是主詞，接著是 will。
dialogue.ja: もう一度、主語のあとに will を置きます。
dialogue.local: Again, you start with the subject and then will.
dialogue.en: Again, you start with the subject and then will.

dialogue.text: After that, you have the base verb.
dialogue.zh: 然後是動詞原形。
dialogue.ja: その後に動詞の原形を続けます。
dialogue.local: After that, you have the base verb.
dialogue.en: After that, you have the base verb.

dialogue.text: You can use the be verb to talk about a confirmed plan.
dialogue.zh: 你可以用 be 動詞來談論已確定的計畫。
dialogue.ja: 確定した計画について話すときは be 動詞を使います。
dialogue.local: You can use the be verb to talk about a confirmed plan.
dialogue.en: You can use the be verb to talk about a confirmed plan.

dialogue.text: I will be at the library tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我明天會在圖書館。
dialogue.ja: 明日、図書館にいます。
dialogue.local: I will be at the library tomorrow.
dialogue.en: I will be at the library tomorrow.

dialogue.text: The economy will get better next year.
dialogue.zh: 經濟明年會變好。
dialogue.ja: 経済は来年良くなるでしょう。
dialogue.local: The economy will get better next year.
dialogue.en: The economy will get better next year.

dialogue.text: In this case, the subject is the economy.
dialogue.zh: 在這個例子中，主詞是經濟。
dialogue.ja: この場合、主語は経済です。
dialogue.local: In this case, the subject is the economy.
dialogue.en: In this case, the subject is the economy.

dialogue.text: Again, we follow with will and the base verb get.
dialogue.zh: 同樣地，我們用 will 加上動詞原形 get。
dialogue.ja: 再び、will と動詞の原形 get を使います。
dialogue.local: Again, we follow with will and the base verb get.
dialogue.en: Again, we follow with will and the base verb get.

dialogue.text: The economy will get better next year.
dialogue.zh: 經濟明年會變好。
dialogue.ja: 経済は来年良くなるでしょう。
dialogue.local: The economy will get better next year.
dialogue.en: The economy will get better next year.

dialogue.text: I'm making a prediction here about something that will happen in the future.
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡對未來會發生的事情做出預測。
dialogue.ja: ここでは未来に起こることを予測しています。
dialogue.local: I'm making a prediction here about something that will happen in the future.
dialogue.en: I'm making a prediction here about something that will happen in the future.

dialogue.text: And finally, I will help you with your homework.
dialogue.zh: 最後，我會幫你做功課。
dialogue.ja: 最後に、宿題を手伝います。
dialogue.local: And finally, I will help you with your homework.
dialogue.en: And finally, I will help you with your homework.

dialogue.text: I'm making a future plan to help you.
dialogue.zh: 我正在做一個幫助你的未來計畫。
dialogue.ja: あなたを助ける未来の計画を立てています。
dialogue.local: I'm making a future plan to help you.
dialogue.en: I'm making a future plan to help you.

dialogue.text: I will help you with your homework.
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你做功課。
dialogue.ja: 宿題を手伝います。
dialogue.local: I will help you with your homework.
dialogue.en: I will help you with your homework.

dialogue.text: It doesn't say when, but I am talking about the future.
dialogue.zh: 雖然沒說明時間，但我是在談論未來。
dialogue.ja: いつかは言っていませんが、未来のことを話しています。
dialogue.local: It doesn't say when, but I am talking about the future.
dialogue.en: It doesn't say when, but I am talking about the future.

dialogue.text: Let's move on.
dialogue.zh: 我們繼續。
dialogue.ja: 続けましょう。
dialogue.local: Let's move on.
dialogue.en: Let's move on.

dialogue.text: You can also use be going to to express a future action.
dialogue.zh: 你也可以用 be going to 來表達未來的行動。
dialogue.ja: 未来の行動を表すのに be going to も使えます。
dialogue.local: You can also use be going to to express a future action.
dialogue.en: You can also use be going to to express a future action.

dialogue.text: It's almost the same as will.
dialogue.zh: 它和 will 幾乎一樣。
dialogue.ja: will とほとんど同じです。
dialogue.local: It's almost the same as will.
dialogue.en: It's almost the same as will.

dialogue.text: Here are some examples.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一些例子。
dialogue.ja: いくつか例を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: Here are some examples.
dialogue.en: Here are some examples.

dialogue.text: There's no milk.
dialogue.zh: 沒有牛奶。
dialogue.ja: 牛乳がありません。
dialogue.local: There's no milk.
dialogue.en: There's no milk.

dialogue.text: I'm going to buy some.
dialogue.zh: 我要去買一些。
dialogue.ja: 買いに行きます。
dialogue.local: I'm going to buy some.
dialogue.en: I'm going to buy some.

dialogue.text: So what you see here is the subject and then the be verb am.
dialogue.zh: 你看到的是主詞，接著是 be 動詞 am。
dialogue.ja: ここでは主語のあとに be 動詞の am が続きます。
dialogue.local: So what you see here is the subject and then the be verb am.
dialogue.en: So what you see here is the subject and then the be verb am.

dialogue.text: I am.
dialogue.zh: 我是。
dialogue.ja: I am（私は）です。
dialogue.local: I am.
dialogue.en: I am.

dialogue.text: And then here, we use a contraction.
dialogue.zh: 然後這裡我們用縮寫。
dialogue.ja: ここでは短縮形を使います。
dialogue.local: And then here, we use a contraction.
dialogue.en: And then here, we use a contraction.

dialogue.text: I'm going to buy some.
dialogue.zh: 我要去買一些。
dialogue.ja: 買いに行きます。
dialogue.local: I'm going to buy some.
dialogue.en: I'm going to buy some.

dialogue.text: I made a decision to buy some because there's no milk.
dialogue.zh: 我決定去買一些，因為沒有牛奶。
dialogue.ja: 牛乳がないので、買うことにしました。
dialogue.local: I made a decision to buy some because there's no milk.
dialogue.en: I made a decision to buy some because there's no milk.

dialogue.text: The next sentence says it looks like it's going to snow tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 下一句說看起來明天會下雪。
dialogue.ja: 次の文は、明日雪が降りそうだと言っています。
dialogue.local: The next sentence says it looks like it's going to snow tomorrow.
dialogue.en: The next sentence says it looks like it's going to snow tomorrow.

dialogue.text: Here the subject is it and so I use the be verb is.
dialogue.zh: 這裡主詞是 it，所以用 be 動詞 is。
dialogue.ja: ここでは主語が it なので、be 動詞の is を使います。
dialogue.local: Here the subject is it and so I use the be verb is.
dialogue.en: Here the subject is it and so I use the be verb is.

dialogue.text: It is.
dialogue.zh: 它是。
dialogue.ja: It is（それは）です。
dialogue.local: It is.
dialogue.en: It is.

dialogue.text: It's is the contraction.
dialogue.zh: It's 是縮寫。
dialogue.ja: It's は短縮形です。
dialogue.local: It's is the contraction.
dialogue.en: It's is the contraction.

dialogue.text: It's going to and then we use the base verb snow.
dialogue.zh: It's going to，接著用動詞原形 snow。
dialogue.ja: It's going to の後に動詞の原形 snow を使います。
dialogue.local: It's going to and then we use the base verb snow.
dialogue.en: It's going to and then we use the base verb snow.

dialogue.text: The word tomorrow shows that this is a future action.
dialogue.zh: tomorrow 這個字表示這是未來的行動。
dialogue.ja: tomorrow は未来の行動を示しています。
dialogue.local: The word tomorrow shows that this is a future action.
dialogue.en: The word tomorrow shows that this is a future action.

dialogue.text: He's going to take a trip in the summer because the subject is he.
dialogue.zh: 他夏天要去旅行，因為主詞是 he。
dialogue.ja: 主語が he なので、彼は夏に旅行に行く予定です。
dialogue.local: He's going to take a trip in the summer because the subject is he.
dialogue.en: He's going to take a trip in the summer because the subject is he.

dialogue.text: We use the be verb is and we can use the contraction.
dialogue.zh: 我們用 be 動詞 is，也可以用縮寫。
dialogue.ja: be 動詞の is を使い、短縮形も使えます。
dialogue.local: We use the be verb is and we can use the contraction.
dialogue.en: We use the be verb is and we can use the contraction.

dialogue.text: He's he is or he's going to and then the base verb take.
dialogue.zh: He's 是 he is 的縮寫，接著是 going to 和動詞原形 take。
dialogue.ja: He's は he is の短縮形で、その後に going to と動詞の原形 take が続きます。
dialogue.local: He's he is or he's going to and then the base verb take.
dialogue.en: He's he is or he's going to and then the base verb take.

dialogue.text: Take a trip in the summer again and action happening in the future.
dialogue.zh: 夏天去旅行，這是未來發生的行動。
dialogue.ja: 夏に旅行に行く、これは未来の行動です。
dialogue.local: Take a trip in the summer again and action happening in the future.
dialogue.en: Take a trip in the summer again and action happening in the future.

dialogue.text: Let's move on.
dialogue.zh: 我們繼續。
dialogue.ja: 続けましょう。
dialogue.local: Let's move on.
dialogue.en: Let's move on.

dialogue.text: Now let's take a look at the negative form of the future simple tense.
dialogue.zh: 現在來看看未來簡單式的否定形式。
dialogue.ja: 次に未来形の否定形を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: Now let's take a look at the negative form of the future simple tense.
dialogue.en: Now let's take a look at the negative form of the future simple tense.

dialogue.text: The first example says Stan will not like his English score.
dialogue.zh: 第一個例子是 Stan 不會喜歡他的英文成績。
dialogue.ja: 最初の例は、スタンは英語の点数を気に入らないでしょう。
dialogue.local: The first example says Stan will not like his English score.
dialogue.en: The first example says Stan will not like his English score.

dialogue.text: No matter what the subject is, we follow with will not and then the base form of the verb.
dialogue.zh: 不管主詞是什麼，我們都用 will not 加動詞原形。
dialogue.ja: 主語が何であっても、will not と動詞の原形を続けます。
dialogue.local: No matter what the subject is, we follow with will not and then the base form of the verb.
dialogue.en: No matter what the subject is, we follow with will not and then the base form of the verb.

dialogue.text: Stan will not like his English score.
dialogue.zh: Stan 不會喜歡他的英文成績。
dialogue.ja: スタンは英語の点数を気に入らないでしょう。
dialogue.local: Stan will not like his English score.
dialogue.en: Stan will not like his English score.

dialogue.text: We won't give you money anymore.
dialogue.zh: 我們不會再給你錢了。
dialogue.ja: もうお金はあげません。
dialogue.local: We won't give you money anymore.
dialogue.en: We won't give you money anymore.

dialogue.text: In this case, the subject is we and we follow with the contraction won't.
dialogue.zh: 這裡主詞是 we，我們用縮寫 won't。
dialogue.ja: この場合、主語は we で、縮約形の won't を使います。
dialogue.local: In this case, the subject is we and we follow with the contraction won't.
dialogue.en: In this case, the subject is we and we follow with the contraction won't.

dialogue.text: It sounds really different and it's different from other contractions.
dialogue.zh: 它聽起來很不一樣，也和其他縮寫不同。
dialogue.ja: 発音が他の縮約形とかなり違います。
dialogue.local: It sounds really different and it's different from other contractions.
dialogue.en: It sounds really different and it's different from other contractions.

dialogue.text: But won't is the contraction for will not.
dialogue.zh: 但 won't 是 will not 的縮寫。
dialogue.ja: しかし、won't は will not の短縮形です。
dialogue.local: But won't is the contraction for will not.
dialogue.en: But won't is the contraction for will not.

dialogue.text: So you can say we will not or we won't.
dialogue.zh: 所以你可以說 we will not 或 we won't。
dialogue.ja: ですから、we will not または we won't と言えます。
dialogue.local: So you can say we will not or we won't.
dialogue.en: So you can say we will not or we won't.

dialogue.text: They're the same.
dialogue.zh: 它們是相同的意思。
dialogue.ja: どちらも同じ意味です。
dialogue.local: They're the same.
dialogue.en: They're the same.

dialogue.text: We won't give you money anymore.
dialogue.zh: 我們不會再給你錢了。
dialogue.ja: もうお金はあげません。
dialogue.local: We won't give you money anymore.
dialogue.en: We won't give you money anymore.

dialogue.text: Again, you notice the base verb give after not.
dialogue.zh: 你會注意到 not 後面接的是動詞原形 give。
dialogue.ja: not の後には動詞の原形 give が続きます。
dialogue.local: Again, you notice the base verb give after not.
dialogue.en: Again, you notice the base verb give after not.

dialogue.text: He is not going to fly until next week.
dialogue.zh: 他直到下週才會飛。
dialogue.ja: 彼は来週まで飛びません。
dialogue.local: He is not going to fly until next week.
dialogue.en: He is not going to fly until next week.

dialogue.text: This sentence uses be going to.
dialogue.zh: 這句話使用 be going to。
dialogue.ja: この文は be going to を使っています。
dialogue.local: This sentence uses be going to.
dialogue.en: This sentence uses be going to.

dialogue.text: The subject is he and therefore the beaver we use is is.
dialogue.zh: 主詞是 he，所以用 be 動詞 is。
dialogue.ja: 主語が he なので、be 動詞は is です。
dialogue.local: The subject is he and therefore the beaver we use is is.
dialogue.en: The subject is he and therefore the beaver we use is is.

dialogue.text: However, we put a not after the beaver.
dialogue.zh: 不過，我們在 be 動詞後面加上 not。
dialogue.ja: しかし、be 動詞の後に not を置きます。
dialogue.local: However, we put a not after the beaver.
dialogue.en: However, we put a not after the beaver.

dialogue.text: He is not going to and then the base verb.
dialogue.zh: He is not going to，接著是動詞原形。
dialogue.ja: He is not going to の後に動詞の原形が続きます。
dialogue.local: He is not going to and then the base verb.
dialogue.en: He is not going to and then the base verb.

dialogue.text: He is not going to fly until next week.
dialogue.zh: 他直到下週才會飛。
dialogue.ja: 彼は来週まで飛びません。
dialogue.local: He is not going to fly until next week.
dialogue.en: He is not going to fly until next week.

dialogue.text: The last sentence says you are not going to go to the party tonight.
dialogue.zh: 最後一句說你今晚不會去派對。
dialogue.ja: 最後の文は、あなたは今夜パーティーに行かないと言っています。
dialogue.local: The last sentence says you are not going to go to the party tonight.
dialogue.en: The last sentence says you are not going to go to the party tonight.

dialogue.text: The subject is you and so we use the beaver are.
dialogue.zh: 主詞是 you，所以用 be 動詞 are。
dialogue.ja: 主語が you なので、be 動詞は are です。
dialogue.local: The subject is you and so we use the beaver are.
dialogue.en: The subject is you and so we use the beaver are.

dialogue.text: You are not going to go that's the base verb to the party tonight.
dialogue.zh: You are not going to go，這裡 go 是動詞原形，表示今晚不去派對。
dialogue.ja: You are not going to go は動詞の原形 go を使い、今夜パーティーに行かないことを表します。
dialogue.local: You are not going to go that's the base verb to the party tonight.
dialogue.en: You are not going to go that's the base verb to the party tonight.

dialogue.text: Let's move on.
dialogue.zh: 我們繼續。
dialogue.ja: 続けましょう。
dialogue.local: Let's move on.
dialogue.en: Let's move on.

dialogue.text: Now let's take a look at how to form basic questions in the future simple tense.
dialogue.zh: 現在來看看如何形成未來簡單式的基本疑問句。
dialogue.ja: 次に未来形の基本的な疑問文の作り方を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: Now let's take a look at how to form basic questions in the future simple tense.
dialogue.en: Now let's take a look at how to form basic questions in the future simple tense.

dialogue.text: The first sentence says he will play with us.
dialogue.zh: 第一句是他會和我們玩。
dialogue.ja: 最初の文は、彼は私たちと遊ぶでしょう。
dialogue.local: The first sentence says he will play with us.
dialogue.en: The first sentence says he will play with us.

dialogue.text: To turn this into a question, all we have to do is change the order of the first two words.
dialogue.zh: 要把它變成疑問句，只要把前兩個字的順序調換。
dialogue.ja: これを疑問文にするには、最初の二語の順序を入れ替えます。
dialogue.local: To turn this into a question, all we have to do is change the order of the first two words.
dialogue.en: To turn this into a question, all we have to do is change the order of the first two words.

dialogue.text: So he will becomes will he.
dialogue.zh: 所以 he will 變成 will he。
dialogue.ja: だから he will は will he になります。
dialogue.local: So he will becomes will he.
dialogue.en: So he will becomes will he.

dialogue.text: Will he play with us?
dialogue.zh: 他會和我們玩嗎？
dialogue.ja: 彼は私たちと遊びますか？
dialogue.local: Will he play with us?
dialogue.en: Will he play with us?

dialogue.text: The next sentence says he is going to play with us.
dialogue.zh: 下一句是他將會和我們玩。
dialogue.ja: 次の文は、彼は私たちと遊ぶ予定です。
dialogue.local: The next sentence says he is going to play with us.
dialogue.en: The next sentence says he is going to play with us.

dialogue.text: This one uses be going to.
dialogue.zh: 這句用的是 be going to。
dialogue.ja: これは be going to を使っています。
dialogue.local: This one uses be going to.
dialogue.en: This one uses be going to.

dialogue.text: The subject is he and so the beaver to use is is.
dialogue.zh: 主詞是 he，所以用 be 動詞 is。
dialogue.ja: 主語が he なので、be 動詞は is です。

dialogue.local: Then we have going to and again the base form of the verb.
dialogue.en: Then we have going to and again the base form of the verb.

dialogue.text: Why are you going to go?
dialogue.zh: 你為什麼要去？
dialogue.ja: なぜ行くのですか？
dialogue.local: Why are you going to go?
dialogue.en: Why are you going to go?

dialogue.text: Now try to find the mistake in the next sentence.
dialogue.zh: 現在試著找下一句的錯誤。
dialogue.ja: 次の文の間違いを探してみましょう。
dialogue.local: Now try to find the mistake in the next sentence.
dialogue.en: Now try to find the mistake in the next sentence.

dialogue.text: You are going to study at home.
dialogue.zh: 你將會在家讀書。
dialogue.ja: あなたは家で勉強する予定です。
dialogue.local: You are going to study at home.
dialogue.en: You are going to study at home.

dialogue.text: Can you find the mistake?
dialogue.zh: 你能找到錯誤嗎？
dialogue.ja: 間違いが見つかりますか？
dialogue.local: Can you find the mistake?
dialogue.en: Can you find the mistake?

dialogue.text: You are going to, that's correct, but we need the base form of the verb.
dialogue.zh: 你是對的用 You are going to，但動詞要用原形。
dialogue.ja: You are going to は正しいですが、動詞は原形でなければなりません。
dialogue.local: You are going to, that's correct, but we need the base form of the verb.
dialogue.en: You are going to, that's correct, but we need the base form of the verb.

dialogue.text: You are going to study at home.
dialogue.zh: 你將會在家讀書。
dialogue.ja: あなたは家で勉強する予定です。
dialogue.local: You are going to study at home.
dialogue.en: You are going to study at home.

dialogue.text: You will be going to learn English.
dialogue.zh: 你會去學英文。
dialogue.ja: あなたは英語を学ぶでしょう。
dialogue.local: You will be going to learn English.
dialogue.en: You will be going to learn English.

dialogue.text: You will be going, hmm, that sounds a little strange.
dialogue.zh: 你會去，嗯，聽起來有點奇怪。
dialogue.ja: You will be going は少し変に聞こえます。
dialogue.local: You will be going, hmm, that sounds a little strange.
dialogue.en: You will be going, hmm, that sounds a little strange.

dialogue.text: Remember, we don't need the will here, we're using B going to and we need to change the B to match the subject.
dialogue.zh: 記得這裡不需要 will，我們用 be going to，且 be 動詞要和主詞一致。
dialogue.ja: ここでは will は不要で、be going to を使い、be 動詞は主語に合わせます。
dialogue.local: Remember, we don't need the will here, we're using B going to and we need to change the B to match the subject.
dialogue.en: Remember, we don't need the will here, we're using B going to and we need to change the B to match the subject.

dialogue.text: You are going to learn English or remember you can also say you will learn English.
dialogue.zh: 你會學英文，或你也可以說 you will learn English。
dialogue.ja: You are going to learn English または You will learn English と言えます。
dialogue.local: You are going to learn English or remember you can also say you will learn English.
dialogue.en: You are going to learn English or remember you can also say you will learn English.

dialogue.text: And finally, is he going to do play soccer?
dialogue.zh: 最後，is he going to do play soccer？
dialogue.ja: 最後に、Is he going to do play soccer? という文です。
dialogue.local: And finally, is he going to do play soccer?
dialogue.en: And finally, is he going to do play soccer?

dialogue.text: Uh oh, we have two verbs here.
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，這裡有兩個動詞。
dialogue.ja: あらら、動詞が二つあります。
dialogue.local: Uh oh, we have two verbs here.
dialogue.en: Uh oh, we have two verbs here.

dialogue.text: Is he going to?
dialogue.zh: Is he going to？
dialogue.ja: Is he going to？
dialogue.local: Is he going to?
dialogue.en: Is he going to?

dialogue.text: That's correct, but we have do and play.
dialogue.zh: 這是對的，但我們有 do 和 play。
dialogue.ja: これは正しいですが、do と play が両方あります。
dialogue.local: That's correct, but we have do and play.
dialogue.en: That's correct, but we have do and play.

dialogue.text: We don't need both.
dialogue.zh: 我們不需要兩個動詞。
dialogue.ja: 動詞は一つだけでいいです。
dialogue.local: We don't need both.
dialogue.en: We don't need both.

dialogue.text: So we say, is he going to play soccer?
dialogue.zh: 所以我們說 is he going to play soccer？
dialogue.ja: だから、Is he going to play soccer? と言います。
dialogue.local: So we say, is he going to play soccer?
dialogue.en: So we say, is he going to play soccer?

dialogue.text: Great job everybody, let's move on.
dialogue.zh: 大家做得很好，我們繼續。
dialogue.ja: みなさん、よくできました。続けましょう。
dialogue.local: Great job everybody, let's move on.
dialogue.en: Great job everybody, let's move on.

dialogue.text: Great job everyone, you now have a better understanding of the future simple tense.
dialogue.zh: 大家做得很好，你們現在對未來簡單式有更好的理解了。
dialogue.ja: みなさん、よくできました。未来形の理解が深まりましたね。
dialogue.local: Great job everyone, you now have a better understanding of the future simple tense.
dialogue.en: Great job everyone, you now have a better understanding of the future simple tense.

dialogue.text: There's still a lot of practice you need to do because this tense is so important.
dialogue.zh: 你還需要多多練習，因為這個時態非常重要。
dialogue.ja: この時制はとても重要なので、練習がまだ必要です。
dialogue.local: There's still a lot of practice you need to do because this tense is so important.
dialogue.en: There's still a lot of practice you need to do because this tense is so important.

dialogue.text: Keep studying and I'll see you in the next video.
dialogue.zh: 繼續學習，我們下個影片見。
dialogue.ja: 勉強を続けて、次の動画でお会いしましょう。
dialogue.local: Keep studying and I'll see you in the next video.
dialogue.en: Keep studying and I'll see you in the next video.
